instruction: Navigate to the page showing the different cabin classes and their amenities.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United Airlines homepage to their cabin classes and amenities page. Uses existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric to verify the URL pattern. No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies navigation to United Airlines cabin classes page by checking URL pattern
Getter (get_active_tab_info) properly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree and returns dict with url/title/content
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly handles dict result and performs regex pattern matching on URL
Expected URL pattern 'united.com/en/us/fly/travel/classes' is semantically correct and specific enough to identify the cabin classes page
Complete coverage: URL verification is appropriate and sufficient for navigation verification tasks
No postconfig needed - getter can access active tab state via accessibility tree
